state.product: MenteViva, an iOS brain-training app for healthy older adults 60+, bought by adult children. v1 scope is done as designed: 4 games (memory pairs, Stroop, category fluency, adaptive math), Jev daily ranking, CloudKit family sharing. Solo developer; v0.2.0 capacity is roughly one focused block of work.
state.current_state: v1 has not had real playtests yet. The strongest-evidence cognitive domain (processing speed, ACTIVE trial) has no dedicated game. Family Sharing exists as CloudKit progress sharing but the purchase/sharing loop has not been validated with real families. Marketing claims are capped at lifestyle level by FDA/FTC constraints.

options_context.polish: Run playtests with real seniors 65+ and fix what breaks: usability, accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA), difficulty curves, ES localization quality. No new features.
options_context.speed_game: Add a fifth game: a generic processing-speed task (time-limited visual discrimination, own implementation since UFOV is licensed). Covers the strongest-evidence domain.
options_context.family_first: Build out the family loop first: polished purchase + Family Sharing + cheer-sending flow, validated with real adult-child purchasers.
options_context.breadth: Add more games across domains for variety, depth later.

state.constraints: Solo dev; small and polished beats broad and shallow is a stated pillar; no playtest data exists yet.

criteria.polish_existing_from_playtest: Playtest-driven polish of the existing 4 games; no new features
criteria.add_processing_speed_game: Build the generic processing-speed game as the fifth game
criteria.build_family_sharing_first: Invest in the family purchase/sharing/cheering loop
criteria.more_game_breadth: Add more games across domains for variety
